title: 桃源行
title_en: Song of the Peach Blossom Spring
author: 王维

text_note.zh: 这里用的是《唐诗三百首》等书里通行的文字。数据库原文有几处不同：第二句“古津”原作“去津”，第十七句“扫”原作“埽”（古代写法），第三十句“几度”原作“几曲”。这些都是不同版本的写法，意思相差不大。
text_note.en: This is the text found in Three Hundred Tang Poems and most common editions. The corpus differs in a few places: in line 2 it has qù jīn (“the ferry they leave”) for gǔ jīn (“the old ferry”); in line 17 it has an old way of writing sǎo (to sweep); in line 30 it has jǐ qū (“how many bends”) for jǐ dù (“how many times”). These are differences between old editions, and the meaning hardly changes.

readings.zh: 隈隩：这里指山水弯弯曲曲、藏在深处的地方。“隩”读 ào，也有书读 yù。
readings.en: In wēi ào, “hidden bends of hills and water”, the second character is read ào; some books read it yù.

readings.zh: 这里的“还”是“又、就”的意思，按今天的读法读 hái。也有人按古义读 huán。
readings.en: Here this character means “also, then”, so it is read hái today. Some readers use the older reading huán.

readings.zh: 攒：聚集在一起，读 cuán，不读 zǎn。
readings.en: This character means “to gather in a cluster”, read cuán, not zǎn.

glosses.zh: 渔舟：打鱼人的小船。
glosses.en: yú zhōu: a fisherman's boat.

glosses.zh: 逐水：顺着溪水往前走。逐，追随、跟着。
glosses.en: zhú shuǐ: following the stream. Zhú means to follow.

glosses.zh: 爱山春：喜爱山里的春天景色。
glosses.en: ài shān chūn: loving the spring in the hills.

glosses.zh: 夹：在两边排着，把中间夹住。
glosses.en: jiā: lining both sides, with the water in between.

glosses.zh: 古津：古老的渡口。津，渡口，就是坐船过河的地方。
glosses.en: gǔ jīn: an old ferry crossing. Jīn is a place where boats cross the water.

glosses.zh: 坐看：坐在船上看着。
glosses.en: zuò kàn: sitting in the boat and watching.

glosses.zh: 红树：开满红色桃花的树。
glosses.en: hóng shù: trees red with peach blossoms.

glosses.zh: 行尽：一直走到尽头。
glosses.en: xíng jìn: going all the way to the end.

glosses.zh: 青溪：清澈碧绿的小溪。
glosses.en: qīng xī: a clear, blue-green stream.

glosses.zh: 潜行：悄悄地、弯着身子往里走。山口很窄，只能慢慢钻进去。
glosses.en: qián xíng: moving in quietly. The opening in the hill was narrow, so he had to creep in.

glosses.zh: 隈隩：山和水弯弯曲曲、藏得很深的地方。
glosses.en: wēi ào: winding, hidden places among the hills and water.

glosses.zh: 旷望：眼前变得很开阔，可以望得很远。
glosses.en: kuàng wàng: a wide, open view.

glosses.zh: 旋：很快，转眼之间。
glosses.en: xuán: soon, in a moment.

glosses.zh: 平陆：平坦的陆地。
glosses.en: píng lù: flat land.

glosses.zh: 攒云树：高高的树木聚在一起，像一团云。攒，聚集。
glosses.en: cuán yún shù: tall trees crowded together like a cloud. Cuán means to gather.

glosses.zh: 散花竹：家家户户之间散布着花和竹子。
glosses.en: sàn huā zhú: flowers and bamboo scattered among the homes.

glosses.zh: 樵客：砍柴的人。这里指那个打鱼人，古人常把渔夫和樵夫连在一起说。
glosses.en: qiáo kè: a woodcutter. Here it means the fisherman; old poems often speak of fishermen and woodcutters together.

glosses.zh: 初传汉姓名：第一次告诉村里人汉代以后的人和名字。也有人理解为：他用汉朝以后的人的姓名来介绍自己。
glosses.en: chū chuán hàn xìng míng: he was the first to tell them names from the Han dynasty and later. Some read it as: he gave his name as a man of later times.

glosses.zh: 居人：住在这里的人。
glosses.en: jū rén: the people who lived there.

glosses.zh: 秦衣服：秦朝时的衣服。他们的祖先在秦朝时逃进山里，从此再没出去过。
glosses.en: qín yī fú: clothes from the Qin dynasty. Their ancestors had fled into the hills in Qin times and never left.

glosses.zh: 武陵源：武陵这个地方的桃花源。武陵在今天湖南常德一带。
glosses.en: wǔ líng yuán: the Peach Blossom Spring in Wuling, near today's Changde in Hunan.

glosses.zh: 物外：人世之外，远离外面的世界。
glosses.en: wù wài: beyond the ordinary world.

glosses.zh: 起田园：开垦田地，建起家园。
glosses.en: qǐ tián yuán: clearing fields and building homes.

glosses.zh: 房栊：房屋的窗户。栊，窗格子。
glosses.en: fáng lóng: the windows of the houses. Lóng is a window frame.

glosses.zh: 喧：热闹地叫着。
glosses.en: xuān: noisy, lively.

glosses.zh: 俗客：从外面世界来的人，这里指渔人。
glosses.en: sú kè: a visitor from the ordinary world, here the fisherman.

glosses.zh: 争来集：争着跑来围在一起。
glosses.en: zhēng lái jí: hurrying over to gather round.

glosses.zh: 竞引还家：抢着请他到自己家里去。
glosses.en: jìng yǐn huán jiā: each eager to invite him to their own home.

glosses.zh: 都邑：城市，这里指外面世界的情况。
glosses.en: dū yì: towns and cities, here meaning news of the outside world.

glosses.zh: 平明：天刚亮的时候。
glosses.en: píng míng: at dawn.

glosses.zh: 闾巷：村里的小巷。
glosses.en: lǘ xiàng: the lanes of the village.

glosses.zh: 扫花开：把落在地上的花瓣扫开。
glosses.en: sǎo huā kāi: sweeping away the fallen petals.

glosses.zh: 薄暮：傍晚，太阳快落山的时候。薄，接近。
glosses.en: bó mù: dusk. Bó means close to.

glosses.zh: 乘水入：坐船顺着水回到村里。
glosses.en: chéng shuǐ rù: coming back in by boat.

glosses.zh: 避地：为了躲避战乱，搬到别的地方去住。
glosses.en: bì dì: moving away to escape war.

glosses.zh: 去人间：离开了人世。
glosses.en: qù rén jiān: leaving the human world.

glosses.zh: 及至：等到。
glosses.en: jí zhì: by the time that.

glosses.zh: 遂不还：就不再回去了。遂，于是、就。
glosses.en: suì bù huán: and so never went back. Suì means and so.

glosses.zh: 峡里：山谷里面，指桃花源。
glosses.en: xiá lǐ: inside the valley, meaning the Peach Blossom Spring.

glosses.zh: 人事：人们的生活。
glosses.en: rén shì: human life and its affairs.

glosses.zh: 世中：外面的世界里。
glosses.en: shì zhōng: in the outside world.

glosses.zh: 空云山：只看见空空的云和山。
glosses.en: kōng yún shān: only empty clouds and hills.

glosses.zh: 不疑：没有想到。
glosses.en: bù yí: not suspecting, not realizing.

glosses.zh: 灵境：神仙住的美好地方，指桃花源。
glosses.en: líng jìng: a magical place where immortals live, the Peach Blossom Spring.

glosses.zh: 难闻见：难得听说，难得见到。
glosses.en: nán wén jiàn: rarely heard of or seen.

glosses.zh: 尘心：想着世俗生活的心。
glosses.en: chén xīn: a heart still tied to the ordinary world.

glosses.zh: 乡县：家乡。
glosses.en: xiāng xiàn: his home town.

glosses.zh: 无论：不管，不在乎。
glosses.en: wú lùn: no matter, not caring.

glosses.zh: 终拟：最后打算。拟，打算。
glosses.en: zhōng nǐ: in the end he planned. Nǐ means to plan.

glosses.zh: 长游衍：长久地在那里游玩、自在地生活。
glosses.en: cháng yóu yǎn: to roam there freely for a long time.

glosses.zh: 自谓：自己以为。
glosses.en: zì wèi: he told himself.

glosses.zh: 经过旧不迷：走过的老路，不会迷路。
glosses.en: jīng guò jiù bù mí: he had been that way before, so he would not get lost.

glosses.zh: 安知：哪里知道。
glosses.en: ān zhī: how could he know.

glosses.zh: 峰壑：山峰和山谷。壑，深沟、山谷。
glosses.en: fēng hè: peaks and valleys. Hè is a deep valley.

glosses.zh: 只记：只记得。
glosses.en: zhǐ jì: he only remembered.

glosses.zh: 几度：好几次，转过好几个弯。
glosses.en: jǐ dù: several times, round several bends.

glosses.zh: 云林：云雾缭绕的树林，指桃花源。
glosses.en: yún lín: woods wrapped in clouds, meaning the Peach Blossom Spring.

glosses.zh: 桃花水：春天桃花开时涨起来的溪水，水上漂着花瓣。
glosses.en: táo huā shuǐ: the spring flood that comes when peach trees bloom, with petals on the water.

glosses.zh: 不辨：分不清。
glosses.en: bù biàn: unable to tell apart.

glosses.zh: 仙源：神仙住的桃花源。
glosses.en: xiān yuán: the immortals' spring, the Peach Blossom Spring.

translation.zh: 渔船顺着溪水往前走，渔人喜爱这山里的春色。
translation.en: A fishing boat follows the stream; the fisherman loves the spring in the hills.

translation.zh: 两岸的桃花，把古老的渡口夹在中间。
translation.en: Peach blossoms line both banks of the old ferry.

translation.zh: 他坐在船上看着红花树，不知道已经走了多远。
translation.en: He sits watching the red-flowered trees and does not know how far he has come.

translation.zh: 一直走到青溪的尽头，也没看见一个人。
translation.en: He follows the clear stream to its end and sees no one.

translation.zh: 从山口悄悄钻进去，起初是弯弯曲曲的深处，
translation.en: He creeps in through an opening in the hill; at first the way winds and hides,

translation.zh: 转眼山势敞开，眼前是一片平地。
translation.en: then the hills open up, and soon there is wide, flat land.

translation.zh: 远远看见一处，高树聚在一起像云一样，
translation.en: Far off he sees tall trees gathered like a cloud;

translation.zh: 走近一看，千家人家散落在花和竹子中间。
translation.en: coming closer, he finds a thousand homes scattered among flowers and bamboo.

translation.zh: 渔人第一次跟他们说起汉朝以后的人和事，
translation.en: The visitor is the first to tell them names from the Han and later times;

translation.zh: 村里人还穿着秦朝时的衣服。
translation.en: the villagers still wear clothes from the Qin dynasty.

translation.zh: 这些人一起住在武陵的桃花源里，
translation.en: Together they live in the Peach Blossom Spring of Wuling,

translation.zh: 在人世之外开垦田地，建起家园。
translation.en: where, far from the world, they have made their fields and homes.

translation.zh: 月光明亮，松树下的房屋窗户静悄悄的；
translation.en: Under a bright moon, the windows beneath the pines are still;

translation.zh: 太阳从云中升起，鸡叫狗吠一片热闹。
translation.en: when the sun comes out of the clouds, the hens and dogs make a cheerful noise.

translation.zh: 听说来了外面的客人，大家又惊又喜，争着跑来，
translation.en: Surprised to hear of a visitor from outside, they hurry to gather round,

translation.zh: 抢着请他回家，打听外面城市里的事。
translation.en: each eager to take him home and ask about the towns outside.

translation.zh: 天一亮，人们就把巷子里的落花扫开；
translation.en: At dawn they sweep the fallen petals from the lanes;

translation.zh: 傍晚，打鱼砍柴的人坐船回来。
translation.en: at dusk the fishermen and woodcutters come home by boat.

translation.zh: 当初是为了躲避战乱才离开人世，
translation.en: Long ago they left the world to escape war;

translation.zh: 后来像神仙一样过日子，就再也不回去了。
translation.en: then they lived like immortals and never went back.

translation.zh: 谁知道这山谷里还住着人呢？
translation.en: Who would guess that people live inside this valley?

translation.zh: 外面的人远远望去，只看见空空的云和山。
translation.en: From the outside world, one sees only empty clouds and hills.

translation.zh: 渔人没想到，这样的仙境是很难再见到的；
translation.en: He does not realize how rare such a magic place is;

translation.zh: 他的凡心还没断，想念自己的家乡。
translation.en: his heart still belongs to the world, and he misses home.

translation.zh: 他走出山洞，不管隔着多少山水，
translation.en: He leaves the cave, not caring how many hills and rivers lie between,

translation.zh: 回家告别了家人，打算以后一直住在仙境里。
translation.en: says goodbye to his family, and plans to come back and stay for good.

translation.zh: 他以为走过的路，再去不会迷路，
translation.en: He thinks he knows the way and cannot get lost;

translation.zh: 哪里知道山峰和山谷，现在全都变了样。
translation.en: how could he know the peaks and valleys have all changed?

translation.zh: 他只记得当时走进了很深的山里，
translation.en: He only remembers going deep into the hills,

translation.zh: 顺着青溪转了好几个弯，才到那片云雾中的树林。
translation.en: and following the clear stream round many bends to the cloud-wrapped woods.

translation.zh: 春天来了，到处都是漂着桃花的溪水，
translation.en: Spring comes, and every stream is full of peach petals;

translation.zh: 再也分不清仙境在哪里，不知到哪里去找。
translation.en: he cannot tell which one leads to the immortals' spring, or where to look.

background.zh: 这首诗是根据东晋陶渊明的《桃花源记》改写的。《桃花源记》讲一个武陵渔人，顺着开满桃花的小溪，走进一个与世隔绝的村子。村里人的祖先在秦朝时为了躲避战乱逃到这里。渔人出来后再去找，却再也找不到了。王维在诗题下自己注明“时年十九”，也就是说，这首诗是他十九岁时写的。
background.en: This poem retells “The Peach Blossom Spring”, a famous prose story by Tao Yuanming. In the story a fisherman from Wuling follows a stream lined with peach trees and finds a hidden village. The villagers' ancestors had fled there to escape war in the Qin dynasty. After he leaves, he tries to go back but can never find it again. Under the title Wang Wei noted that he was nineteen when he wrote it.

author_note.zh: 王维（701—761，一说699—761），唐代著名诗人，也是画家和音乐家。他的诗里常有安静的山水，宋代苏轼说他“诗中有画，画中有诗”。这首诗是他少年时的作品，已经能把一个故事写成一幅幅美丽的画面。
author_note.en: Wang Wei (701–761, or by another account 699–761) was a famous Tang poet, and also a painter and musician. His poems are full of quiet hills and streams. The Song writer Su Shi said there are paintings in his poems and poems in his paintings. He wrote this one as a teenager, yet he already turns a story into a row of lovely pictures.

appreciation.zh: 这首诗像一部短短的电影。开头是渔船、春水和两岸的桃花，美得让人忘了走了多远。接着镜头钻进窄窄的山口，眼前忽然一亮：高树像云，千家人家藏在花竹之间。然后是村里的日子：月下松树旁的窗户很安静，早上鸡鸣狗叫，人们扫花、打鱼，过着没有战争的生活。可是渔人还想着家，出去了再回来，山已经变了样。最后一幅画面是满山满谷漂着桃花的溪水，每一条都像那条路，却哪一条都不是。美好的地方一旦离开，就再也找不回来，留下淡淡的怅惘。
appreciation.en: The poem is like a short film. It opens with a fishing boat, spring water and peach trees on both banks, so lovely that the fisherman forgets how far he has gone. Then the camera slips through a narrow gap in the hills, and suddenly the view opens up: tall trees like clouds, a thousand homes hidden among flowers and bamboo. Next comes village life: quiet windows by the pines under the moon, hens and dogs in the morning, people sweeping petals and fishing, living with no war. But the fisherman still misses home. He leaves, and when he comes back the hills have changed. The last picture is of streams everywhere carrying peach petals. Each one looks like the way in, yet none of them is. Once you leave a perfect place, you can never find it again, and a gentle sadness stays behind.
